{{Top|leg}}
The '''Entrallan Militia''' were a military force based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. [[Roark Slader]] served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the Militia. Some Militia commanders, including Slader, supported a civil uprising on the planet in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] but it was put down by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] with suspected assistance from the [[Guild of Interstellar Merchants]].
